setMailIntro.message: Rows whose target is an e-mail address open a new message here. The message body travels inside the link when it fits; otherwise it is pasted in the editor — measured per row, never guessed.

setMailProvider.description: Label of the provider dropdown and its accessible name — one string, two uses.

setBccAria.description: Accessible name of the BCC address input.

setBccHint.message: A copy in your own mailbox — your record of what went out. Leave empty to skip.

setCustomHint.description: The %tokens% are literal syntax of the URL template — translate only the word before them.

setCustomInvalid.message: The custom template must be an https URL containing %to%.

setFitNoTemplate.message: No step-1 template yet — the fit is measured once a template exists.

setFitMeasuredOne.message: Longest message in this campaign: $COUNT$ character ($ROWS$ rows checked).

setFitMeasuredFew.message: Longest message in this campaign: $COUNT$ characters ($ROWS$ rows checked).

setFitMeasuredMany.message: Longest message in this campaign: $COUNT$ characters ($ROWS$ rows checked).

setFitMeasuredOther.message: Longest message in this campaign: $COUNT$ characters ($ROWS$ rows checked).

setFitYes.message: $PROVIDER$ takes about $BUDGET$ in the link → bodies travel inside the link; the editor opens with everything filled in.
setFitYes.description: Second half of the fit line: the measurement sentence is a separate key, joined with a space in code.

setFitNo.message: $PROVIDER$ takes about $BUDGET$ in the link → long bodies will not fit — the editor opens with the address and subject, the body is copied and pasted with Ctrl+V (Fill does it on web mail).
setFitNo.description: Same slot as setFitYes, for a message that does not fit the provider's link.

setStorageUsed.message: Used $USED$ of $QUOTA$ available to this browser profile.
setStorageUsed.description: Both amounts arrive formatted with their unit (e.g. "12 KB", "1.4 GB").

setStorageUnknown.message: Usage is not reported by this browser.

setOrphansOne.message: $COUNT$ file no campaign refers to any more — $SIZE$.

setOrphansFew.message: $COUNT$ files no campaign refers to any more — $SIZE$.

setOrphansMany.message: $COUNT$ files no campaign refers to any more — $SIZE$.

setOrphansOther.message: $COUNT$ files no campaign refers to any more — $SIZE$.

setNoOrphans.message: Every stored file is referenced by a row or a column default.

setDeleteUnusedConfirmOne.message: Sure? $COUNT$ file ($SIZE$) is erased for good

setDeleteUnusedConfirmFew.message: Sure? $COUNT$ files ($SIZE$) are erased for good

setDeleteUnusedConfirmMany.message: Sure? $COUNT$ files ($SIZE$) are erased for good

setDeleteUnusedConfirmOther.message: Sure? $COUNT$ files ($SIZE$) are erased for good

setDeleteCampaignConfirm.message: Sure? Rows, journal, templates of this campaign go away
setDeleteCampaignConfirm.description: Armed state of setDeleteCampaign — it must stay on one line.

setDeleteAllConfirm.message: Sure? Everything in this extension is erased
setDeleteAllConfirm.description: Armed state of setDeleteAll — it must stay on one line.

assetIntro.message: Images and files for file columns (logos, screenshots). A cell holds the file name; the same content is stored once.

assetEmpty.message: No assets yet. Add logos and screenshots here; file columns refer to them by name.

assetColName.description: Table header. Lowercase on purpose, like the other column headers.

assetShaTitle.message: sha256 $SHA$ — put it into a cell when two files share a name

assetInUse.description: Badge: the file is referenced by a row or a column default.

assetDeleteBlocked.message: Referenced by a row — clear the cell first

assetStorageUsed.description: Both amounts arrive formatted with their unit (e.g. "12 KB", "1.4 GB").
